name: Fengyun-1C
event: Chinese weather satellite destroyed by China's anti-satellite missile test on 11 January 2007; the largest debris cloud ever recorded.

name: Iridium 33
event: Working Iridium communications satellite, destroyed on 10 February 2009 in the first accidental collision between two satellites, with the dead Cosmos 2251.

name: Cosmos 2251
event: Retired Russian military communications satellite, destroyed on 10 February 2009 when it collided with Iridium 33.
